name: VoiceOS
description: VoiceOS is a cloud-connected voice assistant and dictation app for Mac and Windows. It provides text input, selected-text editing, and supported actions in connected apps.
languages: 100 supported languages; see the current language list in the app

pricing.newCustomers: Pro or custom Enterprise; no free sign-up plan
pricing.pro: USD 29.99 billed monthly or USD 143.88 billed annually (11.99 per month equivalent)
pricing.checkout: Availability of trial offers, local currency, and the first charge are shown at checkout.

integrations: See https://www.voiceos.com/app-store for supported actions, platforms, and permissions. Text entry into an app does not imply a dedicated action integration.

safety.actionConfirmation: Varies by tool; the integration catalog marks actions that ask first.
safety.retention: With Help Improve VoiceOS off, raw audio and transcripts are deleted after processing and are not used for VoiceOS model training. Opting in changes retention and training permissions.
